title: Israel Has Killed Esmaeil Khatib, Iran’s Intelligence Minister
partialText: The Israeli military said on Wednesday that it had killed Esmaeil Khatib in an airstrike. Iran confirmed the killing.

title: Israel Intensifies Strikes on Beirut, Escalating Its Campaign Against Hezbollah

title: Netanyahu Hopes Strikes on Iran Will Lead to Uprising and Regime Change

title: N.Y.C. High School Student Freed After 10 Months in ICE Detention

title: Cesar Chavez, a Civil Rights Icon, Is Accused of Abusing Girls for Years
